info.body_text:
After a short trip in Eric's car, they both entered the Galerie Lafayette store with its bright light, elevators, and corners where you can find almost anything.
Feeling Eric's powerful male gaze on her legs, waist and figure, Emilie did not miss a chance to pose like a model, put her perfect silhouette the way it makes her perfect.


Emilie caught him a few times trying to peek under her skirt like a schoolboy. That made her laugh and she found him cute to still have this kid's reflex even if he was a full grown up old man. After a moment of reflection she decided to give him a nice treat, and fulfilled his desire.
She lifted her skirt just a moment when he was right behind her back, in purpose without a doubt possible.


She then winked at him and bite her lips sensually.


Roaming in the alleys, corners and floors, she focused on :
Working clothes
Underwears
SexShop
